schema_version: 1
contract: teacher_agent_http
route_sources:
  student: internal/transport/http/api/v1/router.go
  admin: internal/transport/http/admin/v1/router.go
  internal: internal/transport/http/private/router.go
  telegram: internal/transport/http/integrations/telegram/handler.go
mounts:
  - prefix: /api/v1
    audience: students
    authentication: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers composed by the root router
  - prefix: /admin/v1
    audience: administrators
    authentication: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers composed by the root router
  - prefix: /internal
    audience: services
    authentication: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
  - prefix: /integrations/telegram
    audience: Telegram Bot API only
    authentication: exact X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token
routes:
  student_teacher:
    - GET /api/v1/teacher/me
    - PATCH /api/v1/teacher/me
    - GET /api/v1/teacher/me/soul
    - PATCH /api/v1/teacher/me/soul
    - PUT /api/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/learning-path/plan
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/diagnostic-assessments/complete
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/summarize
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/channels/telegram/link-code
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/onboarding/ensure
    - POST /api/v1/teacher/me/assistant-ui/actions
    - GET /api/v1/teacher/me/next-action
  admin_teacher:
    - GET /admin/v1/personal-teachers/{studentID}
    - GET /admin/v1/personal-teachers/{studentID}/soul
  private_health:
    - GET /internal/healthz
    - GET /internal/readyz
  telegram_webhook:
    - POST /integrations/telegram/webhook
authentication:
  student: trusted gateway actor headers; roles STUDENT and STUDENT_PRO
  admin: trusted gateway actor headers; roles ADMIN and MODERATOR
  private: exact X-Internal-Token; contour disabled when empty
  telegram: exact provider webhook secret; contour disabled when Telegram configuration is incomplete
authorization:
  student_routes: [STUDENT, STUDENT_PRO]
  admin_routes: [ADMIN, MODERATOR]
  private_routes: internal token only
  telegram_webhook: Telegram provider secret only; no gateway actor headers
private_readiness:
  route: GET /internal/readyz
  dense_ordering_diagnostic: read-only EXISTS for schema-v2 jobs when TEACHER_DIALOG_DENSE_ORDERING_ENABLED=false
  pending_statuses: [queued, processing, delivery_pending, blocked]
  blocked_reconciliation_states: [unknown, partial, committed_unreconciled]
  excluded_terminal_statuses: [delivered, completed]
  incompatible_configuration_response: {status_code: 503, status: not ready, error_code: dense_teacher_ordering_disabled_with_pending_v2}
  other_failure_response: {status_code: 503, status: not ready}
  authentication_failure: 403 for missing, wrong, or non-exact token; empty configured token disables contour
  effects: none; durable intake and duplicate ACK independent of claiming flag; no job, response, proof, outcome, or cursor mutation
  excludes: [raw dependency errors, IDs, tokens, counts, private response text, auto-enable, poison skip, requeue, unblock, new no-effect proof policy]
composition:
  - contour routers register endpoints and explicit per-route role middleware
  - root router composes gateway-header authentication and mounts contours
  - private routes remain unversioned under /internal
  - provider-signed webhook routes remain isolated under /integrations and cannot reuse API/admin identity
  - route source files are authoritative for exact paths and parameters
  - no contour may import another contour's handlers, middleware, DTOs, or parsers
teacher_onboarding:
  ensure_schema: teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1
  session_schema: new S11 admission is teacher-onboarding-session.v3 only; exact persisted v1|v2|v3 collecting or terminal evidence remains readable independently of current flags
  session_v2: [schema, dialog_id, status, phase, state_ref, current_prompt_or_terminal]
  session_v2_status: [COLLECTING, PLANNING_READY, ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS]
  session_v2_phase: [GETTING_ACQUAINTED, DETERMINING_START, PREPARING_PATH, READY_TO_START]
  session_v2_constraints: current_prompt only COLLECTING; terminal only PLANNING_READY or ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS; exact state_ref always present; no raw Planner reason, graph, path, or course identifiers
  session_v3: [schema, dialog_id, status, phase, state_ref, current_prompt_or_terminal, optional_path_outcome]
  session_v3_status: [COLLECTING, HANDOFF_PENDING, PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED, ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS]
  session_v3_constraints: current_prompt only COLLECTING; HANDOFF_PENDING exposes display_name and NOT_CREATED; PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED exposes display_name, NOT_STARTED, and NOT_CREATED; ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS exposes no owner identity; optional path_outcome is absent until exact S9 Dialog delivery and contains only kind ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME, status PATH_READY or ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS, and dialog_message_id; no handoff/execution/path/course/lesson/graph IDs reach the browser
  action_schema: assistant-ui-action.v1
  action_result_schema: assistant-ui-action-result.v2
  legacy_action_result_schema: assistant-ui-action-result.v1 exact terminal receipt replay only; never new S11 admission
  canonical_action_result: [schema, mode, materialized, replayed, canonical_student_message_id]
  canonical_action_result_constraints: mode is canonical; materialized is true; canonical_student_message_id is a canonical UUID
  canonical_action_pending_semantics: materialized proves only canonical Student message creation; dense Teacher product turn remains pending; no Student draft or path/course/lesson completion claim
  identity: student_id comes only from trusted actor headers
  action_body: [schema, dialog_id, message_id, message_version, block_id, action_id, idempotency_key]
  retry: frontend must preserve the same idempotency_key for one action intent across transient failure or refresh
  forbidden_action_body: [label, value, answer, student_id, personal_teacher_id]
  caps: {ensure_bytes: 1024, action_bytes: 4096}
  cache: no-store
  historical_session_error: "HTTP 409 exact {error: historical_session_unavailable}; non-retryable; no Retry-After; no downstream mutation"
  errors: {malformed: 400, stale_or_concurrent: 409, dependency: 503}
next_best_action:
  schema: student-next-action.v1
  policy_version: student-next-action-policy.v1
  authoritative_owner: ms-go-student
  source: GET /internal/students/{student_id}/next-action through dedicated Teacher token
  route: GET /api/v1/teacher/me/next-action
  actor: authenticated STUDENT or STUDENT_PRO; query forbidden
  statuses: [READY, WAITING, PLANNING_REQUIRED, NO_PROGRESSION]
  primary: exactly one owner choice when READY; omitted otherwise
  secondary: permitted owner choices; never promoted to primary
  provenance: unchanged context_version, path_version, optional runtime_version, state_digest
  errors: {disabled: 404, malformed_request: 400, dependency_or_contract: 503 nba_state_unavailable}
  http_rollout: TEACHER_NEXT_BEST_ACTION_ENABLED=false_by_default
  conversational: explicit general next-step questions read owner and explain deterministically without model generation
  excludes: [Teacher precedence, workspace traversal, fallback action, progress mutation, Runtime state machine, AI decision]

lesson_dialog_consumer:
  source_schemas: [lesson-message-context.v1, lesson-message-context.v2]
  v1: existing timestamp revision and current Course read; readable legacy history unchanged
  v2_fields: [schema, mode, course_id, lesson_id, content_revision, learning_path_id, learning_path_item_id, content_digest]
  v2_identity: exact immutable UUID revision and frozen Student owner/path/item/course/lesson; selected_text only for selection
  v2_provider: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context with existing shared Student X-Internal-Token
  v2_failure: partial, cross-schema, absent, unavailable, or mismatched projection blocks generation without Course fallback
  prompt: same v2 anchor plus bounded exact overview or selected fragment; no full content
